name: redline
description: A Claude Code plugin that writes ~/.claude/usage.json, shows usage-limit toasts in VS Code sessions where the status line never runs, and adds a /redline command.

toastSeconds.title: Toast duration (seconds)
toastSeconds.description: How long usage toasts stay on screen.

alertToastSeconds.title: Alert toast duration (seconds)
alertToastSeconds.description: How long 95%+ and write-failure toasts stay on screen.

levels.title: Toast levels (percent)
levels.description: Usage percentages that trigger a toast, separated by commas. Enter up to five values from 1 to 100. A 95% toast always appears, so you don't need to list it.

showFiveHour.title: Show 5-hour toasts
showFiveHour.description: Show or hide toasts for the 5-hour window.

showSevenDay.title: Show 7-day toasts
showSevenDay.description: Show or hide toasts for the 7-day window.

timeFormat.title: Time format
timeFormat.description: How reset times are shown. System follows your computer's settings. 12-hour and 24-hour use your local time zone. UTC uses 24-hour UTC.
